report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with durations 78-203 ms; gateway p95 for /v1/checkout is 230 ms and 502 count is 0. Traces show successful inventory, payment, and postgres save_order spans with pool size 1 and idle 1. No fault is established by current evidence; the alert observations are healthy, so no bounded root cause can be substantiated.
missing_evidence: Gateway logs (ev-...-gw_logs) were excluded; need them to check for errors or retries behind the healthy 200s.
Need latency baseline/SLO for /v1/checkout to judge whether 78-230 ms is anomalous.
Need downstream service (order, inventory, payment) latency and error metrics to rule out downstream-latency.
Need Redis and postgres pool saturation/timeout metrics to rule out redis-timeout or db-pool-exhaustion.
Need confirmation of what the alert actually flagged, since all sampled requests succeeded.
